Researchers documented the arrival of fifteen new fish species within the lower Cuyahoga River. Ongoing efforts to eliminate more dams aim to further rejuvenate the Cuyahoga River basin for future generations.

Now known as the Appalachian Highlands Science Learning Center, it plays a crucial role in studying the impacts of climate change and preserving the unique biodiversity of high-elevation ecosystems. They gradually restored native prairie, planted 3,000 sand plum trees, added a five-acre wetland and changed grazing practices. The work transformed the property into habitat for bobwhite quail, grassland birds, deer, ducks and other wildlife, while also encouraging nearby landowners to join a larger habitat corridor project.

The work will repair the historic Rend Trail, replace ageing wooden bridge structures, improve safety and accessibility, and reconnect the 3.2-mile trail with nearby community routes. The National Park Service expects the project to take about 16 months, with the full trail expected to reopen next fall.

She reached this landmark during India's Women's Asia Cup match against Hong Kong China. Mandhana then transitioned to an exceptional T20I century, scoring 124 runs off 64 balls. This remarkable innings also set a new record for the highest individual score in the Women's T20 Asia Cup.

This pristine, undeveloped forest area now forms part of the park's eastern boundary, following congressional legislation passed in 2021 to officially recognize the donation. Protecting popular hiking trails from potential development, this land also ensures the preservation of essential high-elevation ecosystems for the enjoyment of future generations.

This commanding 137-run victory not only showcased India's strength but also secured their entry into the Women's Asia Cup semi-finals, with Mandhana setting new records in women's international cricket.

description: Karnataka government suspended IAS officer Gyanendra Kumar Gangwar due to KPSC recruitment irregularities.  He is currently in CID custody as the agency investigates the commission's alleged wrongdoings.  The Directorate of Enforcement is also conducting a separate investigation into the matter.  Gangwar served as Controller of Examinations at KPSC during the period under scrutiny.  His suspension is effective immediately pending further investigation by the CID.
title: KPSC irregularities: K'taka govt suspends IAS officer facing probe

author: HIJAM RAJU SINGH
description: The BCCI is set to enhance its overseas performance strategy while tackling player injuries. They aim to craft a robust plan in preparation for the 2027 ODI World Cup, which will require adjustments in the Future Tours Programme to prioritise player rest. Recent defeats in white-ball matches against England and Ireland were carefully analysed, and insight was gathered from captains and the head coach regarding fitness protocols.
title: BCCI meeting decoded: Saikia reveals plans for injuries, SENA tours & 2027 WC

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: David Ellsbury honored his late mother's wish by safeguarding the family's cherished Diamond E Ranch from development. Spanning 2,506 acres, this land is now forever shielded by a land trust, ensuring that future generations can enjoy its unspoiled beauty. The ranching traditions of the family will thrive on this preserved estate.
title: After mother's death, Wyoming rancher vowed to protect 2,506 acres forever

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: For over five decades, Jim Bishop dedicated his life to building the biggest one-man castle in the world, starting in 1969. His ambition was fueled by a determination to silence skeptics, initially using his own funds and later gathering donations. After Jim's passing in November 2024, his son Daniel has taken up the monumental task, ensuring the legacy of this extraordinary masterpiece lives on.
title: Jim Bishop bought Colorado land for $450 at 15, then spent 50 years on a castle

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Gloria Steinem, the pioneering feminist activist, author and journalist, has passed away at 92. Following her death, Hillary Clinton, Meghan Markle, Lena Dunham and others paid heartfelt tributes, remembering her influence, generosity and lifelong fight for equality. From women’s rights to reproductive freedom, Steinem’s work inspired generations and left an enduring mark on society.
title: Feminist icon Gloria Steinem dies at 92; tributes pour in

author: HIJAM RAJU SINGH
description: The BCCI is diligently tracking 15-year-old Vaibhav Sooryavanshi's development in cricket. With his remarkable debut as India's youngest men's international player following an explosive IPL performance, the board aims to capitalise on his promise for a sustainable international career. They are keen to ensure he avoids being labeled a fleeting talent while closely mentoring a broader pool of young players at the Centre of Excellence.
title: BCCI’s big plan for Sooryavanshi: ‘Serve like Sachin, not be a one-year wonder’

author: TOI Education
description: UPSC success story: Pankaj Kamboj’s journey to clearing the UPSC CAPF Assistant Commandant examination is marked by repeated setbacks across competitive exams. After failing UPSC CSE Prelims three times and facing several SSB rejections, he continued preparing through self-study while clearing CDS and AFCAT multiple times. Coming from a farming family near the Uttar Pradesh-Uttarakhand border, Kamboj credits his mother for motivating him. He has now cleared CAPF while continuing his UPSC Civil Services journey after clearing Prelims on his fourth attempt.
title: Meet Pankaj Kamboj, who turned repeated defence exam setbacks into CAPF success

author: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK
description: Baljeet Singh, a popular Punjabi singer, was tragically found deceased at his home in Ludhiana, prompting a police investigation initiated by a disturbing odor. Upon arrival, officers discovered his lifeless body on the bed, accompanied by noticeable signs of blood. Disturbingly, Singh had been out of touch with his family for several days. This shocking discovery occurs shortly after the murder of another regional music artist, Ankit Balyan.
title: Punjabi singer Baljeet Singh found dead; police launch probe

author: SHIVANGHI PAYAL
description: Indian banks across various states will be closed on September 4 to observe Krishna Janmashtami. Customers should be aware that further closures will occur throughout the month for additional festivals and elections. It's essential to check local holiday schedules for branch services, although digital banking and ATMs will continue to function normally. Plan accordingly for any urgent in-person banking needs during these times.
title: Bank holiday on Janmashtami: Where are banks closed on Sept 4, 2026? Check list

author: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK
description: Jim Curtis shared his journey of overcoming spinal cord lesions and partial paralysis. He spoke about accepting struggles and finding personal power through self-love. Curtis also advised on navigating life crossroads without abandoning responsibilities. Jennifer Aniston attended the event celebrating his new book, 'The Book of Possibility'. The couple has become more open about their relationship since 2025.
title: Jennifer Aniston's boyfriend Jim opens up on partial paralysis due to nerve damage

author: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK
description: Dedicated to enhancing the lives of Kansas City families, the Patrick and Brittany Mahomes’ foundation offers vital food resources through impactful partnerships. Last Thanksgiving, their efforts resulted in over 200 families receiving festive meal packages. Moreover, the foundation has prioritized food allergy education with a unique back-to-school event, reinforcing their commitment to community health and ensuring everyone has access to nutritious food.
title: Patrick and Brittany Mahomes feed 125 Kansas City families: How are they giving back?

author: TOI BUSINESS DESK
description: Employee bodies have argued that the current 3% annual increment is not sufficient to keep pace with rising expenses. Their recommendations have ranged from 5% to 7%. If such proposals are accepted, a higher increment rate of 5% or 7% would have a direct impact on the salary progression of central government employees.
title: 8th pay commission: How level 8 staff could earn up to Rs 28.89 lakh extra in 10 yrs

author: NITESH DUBEY
description: BCCI secretary Devajit Saikia clarified the situation surrounding Ajit Agarkar's absence from a recent board meeting. He shared that Agarkar was traveling and encountered connectivity problems that prevented him from joining virtually. Saikia also brushed aside any rumors about adjustments to the senior men's selection committee. The meeting primarily reviewed past performances and strategized for the upcoming 2027 ODI World Cup without addressing the potential appointment of a cricket director.

author: TOI SCIENCE DESK
description: Peatlands, which store significant global soil carbon, are now releasing it.  Warming temperatures cause these ecosystems to shift from carbon accumulators to emitters.  This transition occurs rapidly, even with modest warming of four degrees Fahrenheit.  Researchers observed carbon loss rates significantly faster than historical accumulation rates.  These findings impact global climate forecasting models and future predictions.
title: Scientists warmed peat bog by up to 9C; carbon storage flipped to emissions

author: TOI SCIENCE DESK
description: A retired Kodak finance worker and longtime volunteer, Judy Dobles, discovered a previously unknown tardigrade species after collecting moss from a log at New York’s Cumming Nature Center and examining it under a microscope. The species was formally recognised about a year later. Named Mesocrista ojagwaji, it adds to the growing list of tardigrades identified in New York and highlights how much microscopic life remains to be studied.
title: Retired Kodak worker picked moss from New York log and discovered new animal

author: HIJAM RAJU SINGH
description: The BCCI has responded to worries surrounding the accommodation for Indian cricket teams during the Asian Games, with secretary Devajit Saikia assuring that there are no pressing concerns. The board is dedicated to delivering high-quality amenities for both players and staff. Under VVS Laxman’s leadership, the men's team will compete, while Amol Muzumdar coaches the women's team, as India seek to retain their titles.
title: BCCI breaks silence on Asian Games concerns, promises ‘best facilities’ for Team India

author: YASHASVI VASISTHA
description: The Goa Assembly has passed a bill allowing the Goa Housing Board to implement projects. This new legislation enables joint ventures and revenue-sharing models for housing development. The amendment empowers the board to partner with eligible entities for scheme implementation. This move aims to leverage practical and financial advantages for efficient project execution. The state government will soon frame rules for these new development partnerships.
title: Goa's new housing law opens the door to revenue-sharing projects; here's why

author: VISHANT AGARWALA
description: Families in Nuwakot and Rasuwa performed symbolic cremations for missing flood victims.  Relatives used kusha grass effigies when bodies could not be recovered.  Searches for missing kin proved unsuccessful across various locations.  Priests guided families through traditional rituals for liberating souls.  Over one hundred effigies were cremated in Kathmandu's Pashupati Aryaghat.

description: A woman lost fourteen thousand dollars when thieves intercepted her mailed cheques, tampered with the information, and cashed them. This incident sheds light on the escalating issue of mail theft and cheque washing in the Bay Area. Authorities note a concerning rise in mail theft incidents from both postal collection and home mailboxes. For seniors relying on cheques, retrieving lost funds can be particularly challenging.
title: San Francisco woman loses $14,000 after thieves alter checks mailed for bills

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: A 431-acre waterfront parcel in Gloucester County has been officially added to Machicomoco State Park. This undeveloped land, purchased over two decades ago, will now serve as Machicomoco's Western Unit. A newly approved 30-year master plan outlines development phases for both park sections. However, no state funding has been allocated for any of the proposed improvements. Public access to the Western Unit remains restricted, awaiting future financial commitments.
title: Virginia's 431 waterfront acres join another state park after 21-year wait

description: Can the entire difference between a property’s actual purchase price and its stamp-duty value be added to the income of just one of its co-owners? A recent ruling by ITAT Mumbai has addressed this question in a case involving a husband and wife who jointly purchased a property.
title: Couple buys Rs 60L flat, husband taxed on Rs 34.81L stamp-duty gap; ITAT objects

author: JASKARAN SINGH
description: A 26-year-old woman died after a neighbour allegedly attacked her with a knife. The accused reportedly followed her into a house and inflicted multiple stab wounds. Police registered a murder case against the neighbour, identified as Sajan. The victim's husband stated the accused had prior disputes with the family. Authorities are actively searching for the absconding accused.
title: Yamunanagar woman stabbed multiple times by neighbour in front of 4-year-old son, dies

author: YASHASVI VASISTHA
description: At least five African migrants died after their boat encountered trouble at sea. Forty-four survivors were rescued and brought to safety near Gran Canaria. Survivors reported being adrift for nearly a month without provisions. Many migrants suffered dehydration and illness after drinking seawater. The Atlantic route to the Canary Islands remains a dangerous journey.
title: 5 migrants dead after boat carrying over 100 people drifts for weeks in Atlantic

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: Microsoft dismissed two employees for orchestrating an unsanctioned protest at their campus. According to the National Labor Relations Board, the demonstration did not present a tangible workplace issue. The protest organizers were unable to establish a direct connection to employment conditions. Citing an old petition failed to establish relevance. Consequently, the board determined the protest's objectives did not align with activities protected for employees.
title: Microsoft’s firing of anti-Israel campus protesters legal, NLRB rules

author: HIJAM RAJU SINGH
description: BCCI secretary Devajit Saikia defended Rohit Sharma's continued high-level performance in ODIs. He questioned the ongoing speculation regarding the veteran player's future in the team. Sharma himself has previously stated that external noise does not significantly impact his focus. The board's stance comes as the 2027 ODI World Cup approaches. India will eventually need to consider succession planning for the team.

author: TOI SCIENCE DESK
description: Scientists conducted a dye-tracing experiment on Montana's Missouri River.  This study examined how substances move through the waterway over forty miles.  The dye traveled at different speeds through various river sections and reservoirs.  Researchers measured how the dye plume spread along the river's direction.  This data aids in predicting contaminant movement and planning for accidental spills.
title: Missouri River dye test tracked plume 41.2 miles and measured 8.2-hour delay

author: SIDDHI DHARMADHIKARI
description: Central and Delhi government offices will close on September eleventh. This closure is due to the upcoming 18th BRICS Leaders Summit in New Delhi. Extensive security and logistical arrangements are being made for the international event. Leaders from approximately thirty countries will attend the summit and business forum. India is hosting the summit under its 2026 BRICS chairship.
title: BRICS Summit 2026: Delhi, Central govt offices to remain closed on September 11

author: PRANJAL PANDEY
description: India is enhancing its defense relationship with Belgium, focusing on increased security collaboration. The two countries have finalized agreement terms to advance military exchanges and training programs, showcasing commitment. Notably, the indigenous Zorawar light tank, capable of high-altitude warfare, incorporates a turret designed by Belgian firm John Cockerill. Produced in India through a joint venture, India has already ordered 59 Zorawar tanks to address regional security challenges.
title: India's answer to China's Type 15: Inside Belgian-powered Zorawar light tank

description: Bangladesh Prime Minister Tarique Rahman extended Janmashtami greetings to the Hindu community. He stated that the country belongs to all citizens, who enjoy equal rights. Rahman urged strengthening religious harmony, tolerance, and mutual respect among people. He warned against forces attempting to create divisions and communal tensions. The Prime Minister distributed honorariums to priests and sebaits.
title: ‘Diversity is true beauty of society’: B'desh PM extends Janmashtami greetings

author: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK
description: Ajay Devgn and Tiger Shroff have both responded to the notice issued by the Maharashtra FDA, while the wait continues for Shah Rukh Khan's reply. The notice raised concerns about the elaichi advertisement, suggesting it may be promoting Vimal Pan Masala, a product that is banned in Maharashtra. Further developments from the FDA are expected after Khan provides his response.

author: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK
description: Olympic champion Tara Davis-Woodhall survived a serious car crash last week. She sustained a severe concussion in the head-on collision which damaged both vehicles. The accident occurred while she was driving to training at approximately twenty miles per hour. Davis-Woodhall is now focusing on recovery and assessing her ability to compete. Her participation in the World Athletics Ultimate Championship remains uncertain.
title: Tara Davis-Woodhall 'lucky to be alive' after head-on car crash

author: KANISHK SHARMA
description: In her recent remarks, Mayawati emphasized that Akash Anand needs greater political maturity to assume significant roles within the party. She reaffirmed that the Bahujan Samaj Party intends to independently contest all upcoming elections nationwide. Additionally, she labeled the Congress party as distinctly anti-Dalit and anti-Ambedkar, and critiqued the RSS for inconsistencies between their rhetoric and actions.
title: ‘Akash Anand needs to become more mature’: Mayawati rules out major BSP role for nephew

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: MapQuest's refusal to comply with a federal directive to rename Lake Ontario has landed the app at the peak of the US App Store charts. Unlike Google Maps and Apple Maps, which followed the presidential order, MapQuest experienced a remarkable boost, collecting over 1.5 million downloads in North America. The company is now shifting focus towards new features that users are eager for.
title: Apple and Google rename Lake Ontario to Lake America; one app refuses Trump’s order

author: TOI REAL ESTATE DESK
description: Bob Worsley, the visionary behind SkyMall, is parting ways with his picturesque family ranch in Heber, Arizona. Spanning 35 acres, this stunning off-grid estate features a spacious lodge, several cabins, and boasts complete self-sufficiency with solar energy and its own well. The property offers a refreshing retreat from the desert's swelter and includes a natural gathering lake. It's currently on the market for $9.475 million.
title: SkyMall founder's Arizona ranch has 1,250-year-old tree and $9.475m price tag

author: TOI SCIENCE DESK
description: In an ambitious forest restoration initiative in New Hampshire, researchers sought to mitigate the effects of acid rain. They introduced calcium-rich minerals, leading to an initial boost in tree vitality and growth. However, this solution inadvertently resulted in a staggering increase in nitrogen levels in nearby streams, releasing thirty times more inorganic nitrogen compared to untreated regions. This outcome underscores the intricate dynamics of ecosystems in response to human intervention.
title: Scientists treated New Hampshire watershed for acid rain; nitrogen later surged

author: VRITI JAIN
description: West Bengal's Chief Minister warned schools about financial aid cuts for not singing Vande Mataram. He criticized past governments for allegedly destroying the education system and distorting curricula. The Chief Minister stated reforms are underway to restore Indian culture and nationalist values in schools. He also accused the previous government of banning the National Cadet Corps in educational institutions.
title: 'Govt aid would stop': Bengal CM warns schools over Vande Mataram compliance

author: SIDDHI DHARMADHIKARI
description: Food regulator FSSAI has ordered CG Foods India to stop producing Veg Bhujia Namkeen.  Inspections revealed hygiene lapses and unlicensed manufacturing of bhujia products.  The company was found re-processing floor-collected noodles without proper heat treatment.  FSSAI seized over 32,000 kg of stock and detained expired finished goods.  Legal proceedings have been initiated against CG Foods India for these violations.
title: Wai Wai under FSSAI scanner: Firm told to stop production, 32,000kg stock seized

author: HIJAM RAJU SINGH
description: Yuzvendra Chahal dismissed Ben Stokes with a remarkable delivery in the County Championship.  The Indian spinner's magic ball left the England all-rounder completely baffled.  Chahal claimed four wickets for 36 runs in a superb spell.  Stokes has faced difficulties against Indian spinners recently.  This dismissal highlighted Chahal's impressive performance for Northamptonshire.
title: Watch: Chahal’s magical delivery leaves Ben Stokes stunned in County game

author: SMRITI JAIN
description: One of the biggest points of discussion and questioning is the revision to Q1 FY26 GDP at current prices, that is the figures for last year's same quarter numbers. Under the old 2011-12 series, GDP was estimated at Rs 86.05 lakh crore. However, under the new series, it has subsequently been revised to Rs 80 lakh crore.
title: 7.8% growth, but a Rs 6 lakh crore question: Why GDP data has sparked a debate

description: Mohsin Naqvi, chairman of the Pakistan Cricket Board, stood firm regarding the team's latest performances and selection adjustments. He questioned whether a handful of defeats should spell the end of cricket in Pakistan. Noting other teams' challenges, he highlighted Pakistan's advancements in white-ball rankings while also tackling critiques from former players about the management's approach to team building.
title: ‘India lost to Ireland. Has cricket ended?’: Naqvi defends Pakistan's shake-up

description: IIT Madras BS learner Shreyansh Gupta ranked 278th among 46,719 participants at the Google for Developers × Hack2skill PromptWars 2026 hackathon, placing him in the top 0.6%. His solution for improving large-scale sporting event experiences scored 88.81/100 in AI evaluation, including 100/100 for efficiency. Beyond hackathons, Shreyansh is building experience across AI agents, full-stack development, augmented reality and student technology initiatives, reflecting his focus on turning technical skills into practical solutions.
title: Meet Shreyansh Gupta, IIT Madras student ranked in top 0.6% of Google hackathon

author: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK
description: The NBA has delivered a harsh blow to the Los Angeles Clippers, penalizing them for salary-cap violations linked to Kawhi Leonard. The repercussions include forfeiting five first-round draft picks and substantial financial penalties, alongside suspensions for owner Steve Ballmer and several executives. Leonard himself faced a fine of $700,000. In response, the Clippers dispute the allegations and are gearing up to challenge the league's decision.
title: NBA hammers Clippers: Ballmer banned, picks stripped, Kawhi fined $700k

author: SHIVANGHI PAYAL
description: The United States has successfully negotiated a deal to import Venezuelan oil, aiming to replenish its reserves with a consistent supply of affordable crude. While the long-term implications for American drivers remain ambiguous, the deal's effect may not be felt for several months. The arrangement involves significant untapped oil fields and a private company, but future political developments in both nations could pose risks to this energy collaboration.
title: US-Venezuela's historic deal: Will Americans get cheaper gas now?

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Melanchton Cliser and his family were among the residents forced from their Virginia home as land was acquired for Shenandoah National Park in the 1930s. Cliser owned 46 acres along US 211 and operated a gas station. In October 1935, the local sheriff and deputies handcuffed him, removed the family's belongings and sealed their house. His case was part of a wider and often contentious effort that displaced hundreds of families from the Blue Ridge Mountains as the park took shape.
title: Virginia man refused $4,855 for land and was evicted as Shenandoah park formed

description: In an alarming incident in San Francisco, a heroic garbage truck rescue took place after a bystander detected distressing screams. The dealer's appeal was dismissed, upholding the original order for payment and compensation.

Government measures like import allowances and stock curbs aim to stabilize prices.

A video shows a man slapping Bapat during his statement to reporters. Police are working to identify the attacker and ensure Bapat's safety. Bapat's campaign against loud DJs has gained significant public support statewide.

Together, they exemplify India's rising prowess in global powerlifting arena.

His research brings the often-ignored environmental costs into the public eye, prompting critical discussions among society.

author: TOI SCIENCE DESK
description: A groundbreaking experiment conducted in Ontario's Lake 260 unveiled alarming ecological consequences stemming from synthetic estrogen exposure. The minuscule amounts of 17α-ethynylestradiol resulted in reproductive failure among fathead minnows, nearly driving the species to extinction. This critical study highlighted how even minimal contaminant levels can dramatically disrupt aquatic ecosystems. Researchers caution that wastewater containing estrogens poses significant threats to aquatic biodiversity.
title: Ontario lake minnow population collapsed after synthetic estrogen experiment

description: Lewis Hamilton and Kim Kardashian’s relationship has sparked fresh online attention after a viral post made a surprising claim about their finances. The post alleged that Kardashian prefers paying for everything and would continue the arrangement if they eventually married. While the pair have been linked romantically and have appeared together publicly, the dramatic money claim has not been backed by a credible interview or direct statement from Hamilton.
title: Lewis Hamilton and Kim Kardashian spark fresh buzz over relationship finances

author: SHIVANGHI PAYAL
description: On Thursday morning, the Indian rupee saw a notable rise, fueled by an influx of foreign-currency deposits that enhanced the foreign-exchange liquidity of the country. This robust support helped mitigate global economic pressures. Additionally, interventions from the Reserve Bank of India played a crucial role in the rupee's ascent, as domestic equities began the day on a positive note, signaling encouraging market sentiments.
title: Rupee gains 47 paise as record FCNR inflows boost forex liquidity

title: Thar crushes bike-borne man, woman in Delhi Cantt; both die

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: Google and Alphabet CEO Sundar Pichai has shared a video message with IIT Kharagpur as the institute marks 75 years, recalling meals at Harry's, the Illu festival, nights studying in room B-308, and meeting his wife Anjali on campus. The Google CEO, a 1993 metallurgical engineering graduate, also shared his AI prediction for the next five years, saying artificial intelligence will move from labs into the hands of farmers, doctors and government workers.
title: Google CEO Sundar Pichai sends message to IIT Kharagpur as it celebrates 75 years

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: A historic high school in West Virginia, originally established in 1923, has been beautifully transformed into a 40-room boutique hotel. The once-abandoned classrooms now serve as cozy guest rooms and inviting lounges, offering visitors a unique stay. This renovation breathes new life into a campus that had been closed for more than ten years, blending its historic charm with contemporary residential design.
title: West Virginia high school built in 1923 reopens as 40-room hotel

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: A significant eight million dollar grant has facilitated the acquisition of one thousand six hundred eighty-eight acres of land for public use. This area safeguards a crucial wildlife corridor and an undammed river, enhancing conservation efforts for native fish habitats and seasonal wildlife migration. The Park Ranch, located near Markleeville, transitioned to Alpine County's management in August, with public access planned following the development of a thorough management strategy.
title: California grant moves 1,688 ranch acres into public ownership for conservation

author: SHIVANGHI PAYAL
description: The State Bank of India has challenged assertions of low nominal GDP growth, asserting that the 2.6% figure arose from inconsistent data comparisons. The bank highlights that the official real GDP growth for Q1 FY27 remains robust at 7.8%. It's common for quarterly GDP figures to be adjusted, and further revisions will continue until the data is finalized.
title: 'Intellectual dishonesty': SBI hits back at 2.6% GDP growth claim

author: SHUBHANSHU DWIVEDI
description: Babar, along with the Pakistan squad and Pakistan Cricket Board (PCB) chairman Mohsin Naqvi, visited Clarence House on September 2. During the meeting, Babar handed the King a bat signed by all the players as a gesture of goodwill and sportsmanship.
title: Babar Azam, Mohsin Naqvi meet King Charles III amid England tour turmoil

author: VIJAYA SRIVASTAVA
description: In a pivotal move, Tamil Nadu's Chief Minister plans to introduce a resolution advocating for Tamil's recognition as a principal language. This proposal would ensure that legal rulings and decrees can be issued in Tamil, reinforcing its classical language status. It will leverage technology and appeal to current legal frameworks, echoing efforts made by the assembly in 2006 for similar recognition.
title: Tamil for Madras HC: CM Vijay to move resolution urging Centre's approval

author: HEENA GUPTA
description: In a recent exchange, Meta's chief AI officer took a jab at Google's Gemini AI model following the impressive performance of Meta's Muse Spark 1.3 on a key industry benchmark. This new version not only excelled in agentic tasks and scientific reasoning but also offered a cost-effective solution compared to its competitors. Meta's relentless push in advanced AI development remains evident.
title: Meta's highest-paid employee Alexandr Wang can't stop making fun of Google

author: TANUJ LAKHINA
description: As Super League Kerala prepares for its third season, the league is betting on sustainability over spectacle. CEO Mathew Joseph outlines a club-first financial model, grassroots talent development, digital innovation and global broadcasting ambitions, while introducing India's first penalty shootout-decided league format. The goal is clear: transform Kerala's football passion into a sustainable ecosystem for Indian football.
title: How Super League Kerala is trying to build Indian football from the ground up

author: MAHIMA SHARMA
description: In the wake of catastrophic flash floods in the Nepal-Tibet region, the death toll has tragically reached 1,243. Rescue teams are struggling against relentless rainfall and thick debris as they search for those trapped. Prime Minister Balendra Shah has emphasized the link between this disaster and climate change on a global scale. Authorities are now initiating temporary burials for the deceased while receiving international support for identification and recovery missions.
title: Relatives hold symbolic funerals for thousands missing as Nepal toll crosses 1,243

title: US reacts to PM Modi-Iran prez meet; issues warning to countries 'helping' Tehran

author: SHUBHANSHU DWIVEDI
description: The 22-year-old, seeded 32nd, defeated American Marcos Giron 3-6, 6-3, 6-3, 6-7(6), 6-1 in a match that lasted three hours and 48 minutes on Court Six.
title: Peruvian tennis player registers 1st US Open win 68 years after grandfather's last victory

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: Robert Kiyosaki perceives his significant debt as a tactical resource for wealth generation. He utilizes borrowed capital to purchase income-producing real estate, positioning this strategy against the typical mindset of debt avoidance. By securing his debt against properties and collaborating with partners, Kiyosaki promotes the informed application of debt as a formidable financial instrument.
title: Kiyosaki’s billion-dollar debt: How 'Rich Dad Poor Dad' author treats leverage as ‘good debt’

author: SMRITI JAIN
description: Top stock market recommendations: Bank of Maharashtra, Glenmark Pharma, and Tata Technologies have been shared as the top stocks to buy today on September 3, 2026 by Aakash K Hindocha, Vice President - Research, Nuvama Professional Clients Group/Nuvama Wealth.
title: Top stocks to buy: Stock recommendations for today - check list

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: New York City schools are placing strict limits on artificial intelligence use for students. Younger students face the most significant restrictions, with AI banned until high school. High school students will have limited AI access for specific educational purposes. Teachers can use AI for lesson planning and translation tasks. Centrally approved instructional programs and assistive technologies are exempt from these new rules.
title: Read Mayor Mamdani's statement as New York bans AI in school

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: During a spirited skating competition, young Tangtang faced a setback by falling right from the start. Demonstrating remarkable perseverance, she rose swiftly and began to pursue her fellow competitors, ultimately securing the lead. This inspiring recovery serves as a crucial reminder for parents on teaching their children resilience. Failures are an undeniable part of life, and guiding children in navigating these difficult moments is essential.
title: 7-year-old falls in skating race, then stages epic comeback

author: MANISHA GUPTA
description: Siddhartha Manaktala, at just 17 years old, has developed EyeSpy, an innovative AI smartphone app tailored for eye disease screening. In rural Haryana, he has successfully screened over 1,650 individuals, many of whom were previously unaware of their vision problems. With enhancements from the L V Prasad Eye Institute, EyeSpy now identifies seven eye diseases and operates offline on basic smartphones.
title: Gurugram teen's AI app screens 1,650 villagers after grandma's eye illness

author: TOI REAL ESTATE DESK
description: In July, UK mortgage approvals for home purchases hit a new low, highlighting a weakened demand in the housing market amid rising borrowing costs. Additionally, net mortgage borrowing plummeted, falling below the six-month average. While house prices saw slight annual growth, they decreased when adjusted for inflation. Conversely, unsecured consumer borrowing rose, revealing an increasing dependence on credit for everyday spending.
title: UK mortgage approvals fall to lowest level since January 2024 as housing demand weakens

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: Palantir's chief executive, Alex Karp, has stepped into the role of principal investor for an innovative defense tech firm established by former Ukrainian Defense Minister Mykhailo Fedorov. This enterprise's mission is to leverage Ukraine's battlefield expertise, transforming wartime knowledge into advanced technology solutions for Ukraine and its allies, drawing from the real-life experiences of the ongoing conflict against Russia.
title: Former Ukrainian defence minister launches Palantir-backed defence tech firm

author: TNN
description: A young woman was found dead in her rented home after allegedly being strangled. Police suspect her husband, Yash Thakur, who reportedly assaulted her previously. Authorities were alerted to a dispute between the couple on August 31. The husband allegedly locked the room and fled after the incident occurred. Police teams are actively searching for the suspect to make an arrest.
title: Met on Insta, married 2 yrs later: Woman found dead at rented house, husband flees

title: IAF commander who shot down Pak jet after Balakot strikes joins private airline

author: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK
description: In a recent statement, Donald Trump commented on the return of Prince Harry and Meghan Markle to Britain, stating his discontent as he wouldn't have welcomed them back. Trump, who fondly recalled his relationship with Queen Elizabeth and King Charles, criticized the couple for their perceived disrespect toward the royal family, declaring that had he been in a royal position, their return would not have been acceptable.
title: Donald Trump reacts to Prince Harry and Meghan Markle’s UK move

title: US judge partially halts Trump’s latest birthright citizenship order

author: JYOTIRMOY HALDER
description: American Grandmaster Levon Aronian has revealed how Praggnanandhaa turned a weakness he identified last year into a strength, helping the Indian grandmaster win the Grand Chess Tour (GCT) Finals. Aronian, who had beaten Praggnanandhaa in GCT Finals last year, praised the youngester's progress and fighting spirit while admitting he was surprised by how quickly the Indian closed that gap.
title: 'I'm surprised': American GM after Pragg wins India's historic GCT title | Exclusive

author: HADI KHAN
description: Rajya Sabha MP Raghav Chadha alleges political vendetta by the Punjab AAP government. His name was marked as 'shifted' in the state's draft electoral roll. Chadha states his voter ID is registered in Mohali, Punjab. He is pursuing remedies during the ongoing claims and objections process. Final electoral rolls will be published in October 2026.
title: ‘AAP burning with anger’: Raghav Chadha's name 'shifted' from Punjab draft SIR

description: Gracie Hunt, the billionaire Kansas City Chiefs’ heiress, has made a new investment as she gears up for the new season.
title: Gracie Hunt invests millions in wellness ahead of the new NFL season

author: JYOTIRMOY HALDER
description: American chess grandmaster Hans Niemann urged FIDE to punish players for publicly making accusations, especially involving young competitors. His comments came after Ian Nepomniachtchi questioned a move by 14-year-old Canadian IM Aaron Mendes during their Titled Tuesday game. Nepomniachtchi described the move as suspicious, while Mendes went on to win after Nepomniachtchi’s blunder and eventual resignation.
title: ‘FIDE must punish players’: Hans slams Russia No. 1 Nepo over comments on 14-yo

author: TOI REAL ESTATE DESK
description: Alex Trebek’s former 720-acre California estate, Windfall Farms, has sold at auction for $16.9 million after more than a year on the market. Listed for $33 million in 2025, the Paso Robles property features 387 acres of vineyards, a 6.5-furlong racetrack, four equestrian barns, paddocks, residences and a 10,000-square-foot main house.
title: Alex Trebek's 720-acre horse ranch sells at auction for $16.9m

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Georgian Bitcoin financier George Bachiashvili has sold his Miami mansion for a record $51.5 million. He bought the unfinished property for $19 million in 2021, later transforming it into a luxury waterfront estate. Listed for $55 million in August, the mansion sold in just 11 days, as Bachiashvili’s whereabouts remain undisclosed amid his legal saga.
title: Georgian Bitcoin financier sells Miami mansion for record $51.5m profit

author: SHIVANGHI PAYAL
description: Oil prices took a minor dip on Thursday following a turbulent trading day. Investors are closely monitoring the repercussions of the US-Iran strikes on oil supply lines. Activity in the Strait of Hormuz is currently lower than average. This disruption fosters worries regarding global oil availability and possible price hikes as countries explore alternative sources while depending on diminishing reserves.
title: Oil price today: Crude continues to trade beyond $95 per barrel

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: This week, Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick expressed renewed confidence in AI firm Anthropic, signaling a major diplomatic shift following previously imposed export restrictions. Tom Brown, co-founder of Anthropic, has been pivotal in repairing ties with Washington, engaging in proactive discussions and gaining recognition for the company’s data center expansion. Additionally, a recent ruling from a federal judge invalidated the Pentagon's previous blacklisting of Anthropic, further solidifying its standing.
title: US government now 'trusts' Anthropic, the company that it banned months ago

title: 60 targets, 18m oil barrels: Inside US military’s record strike on Iran

author: ANKUR SIROTHIA
description: In a decisive move, the Madhya Pradesh government has crafted a five-point reply to present to the Supreme Court concerning minister Kunwar Vijay Shah’s controversial comments. The state cabinet has opted not to grant sanction for his prosecution, noting the absence of any complaints against him. They assert that he neither specified any officer nor failed to apologize.
title: 'No complaint, no insult': MP denies nod to prosecute BJP neta for Col Qureshi remarks

author: ARVIND CHAUHAN AND SHALABH
description: The Shri Ram Janmabhoomi Teerth Kshetra Trust has inducted three new trustees. Swami Govind Dev Giri was elevated to general secretary while Mahesh Bhagchandka became treasurer. Bhagchandka brings business and philanthropic experience to the expanded governing body. Madan Mohan Pandey and Dr Nirmala Yadav also joined the trust's board. These appointments fill all vacant positions and strengthen the trust's administrative framework.
title: Ram Temple Trust inducts 3 new trustees, elevates Govind Giri as general secretary

author: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK
description: Yash's film 'Toxic' saw a thirty-five percent dip in earnings on its eighth day.  The movie collected five point one zero crore net in India on Wednesday.  Its domestic total has now reached two hundred thirty-four point seven zero crore net.  Worldwide gross collection for 'Toxic' crossed three hundred twenty-two crore on day eight.  Kannada screenings recorded the strongest audience occupancy among major language versions.
title: Toxic box office day 8: Yash film drops 35%, earns Rs 5.1cr

author: NITESH DUBEY
description: Pakistan cricket has struggled with ongoing coaching instability, marked by numerous changes and management reshuffles since September 2021. The Pakistan Cricket Board has tried various structures and roles for senior management, leading to short-lived appointments of prominent figures like Jason Gillespie and Gary Kirsten. This unpredictable pattern underscores a long-standing challenge within the sport, raising questions about the team's direction and consistency.
title: 11 coaches in 5 years: Inside Pak cricket’s never-ending coaching carousel

author: JYOTIRMOY HALDER
description: Pakistan Cricket Board Chairman Mohsin Naqvi defended sweeping Test squad and coaching changes after Pakistan’s heavy 2-0 series loss to England. Seven players were dropped and five uncapped players added, while Mike Hesson and Ashley Noffke took coaching roles. Despite criticism from former cricketers and fans, Naqvi called the decisions "essential" and defended his record, highlighting progress in white-ball cricket.
title: 'Look at what the rankings were before': PCB chief Naqvi hits back at critics

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: California Governor Gavin Newsom has listed his sprawling Fair Oaks mansion for $7.5 million, nearly double the $3.7 million he paid in 2018. The 8.2-acre estate features seven bedrooms, 12 bathrooms and luxury amenities including a swimming pool, full-size tennis court, cold plunge, hot tub and a 5,000-bottle wine cellar.
title: Gavin Newsom lists 8-acre Fair Oaks estate for $7.5m, double 2018 price
